$comment: Archived API versions shown in the docs version picker, newest first. The latest version always comes from specs/public_openapi_spec.json (S3 openapi.json). Archived versions are not built into the repo: the docs server fetches each one's spec from the public open-mrp/openapi-spec repo at the tag in specTags (its last {version}-rev.{N}) the first time someone opens it (src/lib/archived-api-versions.ts). scripts/archive-previous-api-version.ts fills both in on release.
